A Pick is useful for many things, one of them is to open hidden holes in patches of mud. These holes normally take you to quests or hunting places that people normally don't know of. There are a total of 42 Pickable Holes in Tibia (currently, not all of them are shown here).

List of Pickable Holes

Free account places

Rookgaard

  • In the cave where the bear room quest is located, there is a pick hole south of the table where the minotaurs spawn that you have to pick, here (32149, 32110, 11). When you go down the hole, you find the key to the bear room.

Folda

  • There's a pickhole located in the end of a room that contains minotaurs and rotworms, here (31979, 31564, 8). This room is in the first underground floor and has a lot of bones scattered around so it's easy to find. In this hole you will find a big square room containing some weak monsters - a good place to train while being hidden from players.

Fire Devils at Spike Sword Quest

  • Go north-east of the Triangle Tower, following the water until you see a small mountain with a cave, leading to 2 dwarves. In here (32595, 32068, 9) use the pick and you will find a hunting place with Fire Devils, if you pick again here (32580, 32103, 11) you will reach the Spike Sword Quest area.

Ancient Temple

  • There is a pickhole in the Rotworm cave. It takes you directly to the undead cave below Mount Sternum.
  • After a bridge that you can lift, there are some Bonelords. In the end of this room there's a hidden hole here (32437, 32239, 10) with a quest and 3 more Bonelords to hunt.

Mount Sternum undeads

  • There are several hidden holes that lead to an area with Dragons. Also the other hidden hole leads to a Giant Spider and a slime, that can be used to train. Another one leads to some cave rats, but be careful in there as this has a rare spawn of Grorlam.

Alatar Lake

  • In the northern section of the cave below Alatar Lake there is a hidden hole here (32395, 32110, 8) which leads to some squares in between two barriers. Nothing can be killed down here.

Plains south of Thais

  • Single Banshee spawn. There's a backdoor to hunt the Banshee if you don't have the enough level to cross the front door (there is a level 25 Gate of Expertise). Just bring 3 stackable objects (eg. parcels or crates) to go up a hill in the most southern part (near the Cyclops Camp), in here you will find some ruins and a mud tile, use pick here (32328, 32413, 7) and down (there are 3 Stalkers here). Pick again in the room and you will be able to go down to a place with stairs to fight the Banshee at any level.
  • Under the White Flower Temple there's a room with 2 bugs, in here you can also use a pick to go down to a hunting place, watch out for a single Demon Skeleton and some slimes.

Thais

  • Thais Sewers, here (32302, 32257, 8).

Ghostlands and Isle of the Kings

There are several pickable holes around The Queen of the Banshees Quest area.

  • Right after the entrance through the Ghostlands there are 2 pickable holes on the same corridor, here (32266, 31892, 12) and here (32266, 31916, 12).
  • There is a pickable hole in the Giant Spider room here (32204, 31887, 14).
  • Right under the building of the Isle of the Kings, there is a pickable hole here (32162, 31921, 13) and another one on the lower floor here (32165, 31890, 14).

Premium Places

Darama Terramite Cave

  • On the western side of the cave, here (33027, 32707, 8).

Okolnir

  • Down a hole on the southeastern part of the island, here (32295, 31441, 8).

Talahu

  • After going up the stairs go south pass 2 Hydras and enter the first pitfall that has some Quaras, then go east to the next pitfall that also has some Quaras and Bog Raiders, then go north until you see a single mud tile. Use the pick here (31928, 32670, 9) to go to to the hidden Quara city.
  • There is a pick hole here (31947, 32593, 9) which is the entrance of the Lich Hell.

Edron

  • You need to pick a hole to get the reward of Fire Axe Quest in Edron Dragon Lair, here (33081, 31651, 11).

Hero Cave

  • There is a hole that leads to a single Demon spawn in the Parchment Room Quest.
